name: Teleporting Vanishing Ball
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 456 current-evidence enrichment: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ62. The user creates a Ki ball behind a shield, teleports to the locked-on opponent, and launches the ball at close range; current dedicated evidence documents 15 hits and about 30% total damage. Exact teleport invulnerability timing and patch-independent scaling are not inferred.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
